journey: Explore as a guest
current_prototype: Partial: six-step guest tool exists; durable server guest draft and entry looks do not.
acceptance: Guest reaches fabric and review without mandatory login, photo upload or tour. First edit has an observable saved/pending state.
evidence_basis: SS01–SS02; avoid intrusive tours; Huntsman process clarity.

journey: Occasion, deadline and recommended looks
current_prototype: Partial: occasion is recorded; recommendations and deadlines are absent.
acceptance: Occasion changes the recommendations rather than only recording a label. Event readiness distinguishes delivery from required fitting time. Cancel leaves the existing suit unchanged.
evidence_basis: SS03; Huntsman service-led entry; deadline complaints across review sample.

journey: Browse and filter the fabric collection
current_prototype: Partial: three real fabric choices and photo changes; full catalogue/filter/inventory handling absent.
acceptance: Result count matches the actual list. Opening details and Back preserve filters/scroll. Late image results cannot overwrite a later selection.
evidence_basis: SS02; HK02–HK04; PC02–PC04.

journey: Inspect cloth and request a physical sample
current_prototype: Partial: swatch detail dialog exists; verified rich metadata and sample fulfilment do not.
acceptance: Swatch source matches code throughout. Sample status distinguishes requested, accepted and shipped. No personal address is requested for digital-only inspection.
evidence_basis: HK04; PC04; real-swatch confidence concerns.

journey: Shortlist and compare fabrics
current_prototype: Absent in current local client tool; older v2 fabric-comparison experiment is not this implementation.
acceptance: Removing an item updates both tray and comparison. Merely inspecting an alternative never changes the selected fabric.
evidence_basis: HK04 and PC04 information patterns; proposed NYONI comparison.

journey: Choose silhouette and tailoring details
current_prototype: Partial: one jacket construction, three lapels and fixed trousers; no dependency engine or broader silhouettes.
acceptance: Every selected option maps to a production ID. Reopening a detail restores its committed value. Conflicts cannot survive into quote approval.
evidence_basis: SS03–SS07; HK05; PC05–PC07; IN05.

journey: Choose buttons, lining and monogram
current_prototype: Partial: real button/lining selection and text monogram exist; accurate interior/thread/placement rendering absent.
acceptance: Review/export and production record match the selected supplier components. A catalogue substitution requires explicit reapproval.
evidence_basis: SS04–SS05; HK06; Proper Cloth selected-button mismatch review.

journey: Add a photo with informed consent
acceptance: Uploading alone cannot trigger a paid generation. No public image URL, raw photo analytics or automatic marketing consent. Skipping photo preserves all garment choices.
evidence_basis: Proposed; personal-preview plan and provider capability research, not verified competitor VTON.

journey: Generate and inspect a personal preview
current_prototype: Absent; provider has not been selected or benchmarked.
acceptance: Job and image reads are owner-authorized. A rejected likeness/body/garment result is not silently displayed as successful. Generation never edits the underlying tailoring specification.
evidence_basis: Proposed; no competitor review proves identity or fit accuracy.

journey: Change design after personal generation and compare looks
current_prototype: Absent for personal previews; studio switching exists.
acceptance: Select A, request B, edit to C, then receive B: result B cannot become current C. Deleting an image does not delete its garment specification.
evidence_basis: Current image-layer research plus proposed personal job lifecycle.

journey: Recover, replace or remove a personal photo
acceptance: Old image links expire or are revoked under the stated policy. Replacement cannot reuse another person asset or resurrect deleted output.
evidence_basis: Provider-retention research; proposed privacy requirement.

journey: Save and resume a guest design
current_prototype: Partial: same-browser local draft works; durable guest service and conflict resolution absent.
acceptance: Reload reproduces committed values. Save is never submission. Invalid old schema migrates safely or preserves a recoverable export.
evidence_basis: SS10; Hockerty restart complaint; existing local draft tests.

journey: Create an account, link a draft and share a design
acceptance: Other accounts cannot enumerate or edit private drafts. Expiry/revocation works. A shared view cannot mutate the owner’s suit.
evidence_basis: SS10 was same-browser only; account/share are proposed.

journey: Returning member and verified entitlement
current_prototype: Absent; current tool makes no live entitlement claims.
acceptance: No entitlement derived from frontend labels. Quote, checkout and staff view agree; failed payment/redemption releases reservations according to real policy.
evidence_basis: Original NYONI membership intent; proposed business integration.

journey: First-time client chooses a fit route
current_prototype: Partial: fitting preferences exist; service directory and live requests absent.
acceptance: A personal image never implies verified measurements. Client can change route without losing design or overwriting a previous profile.
evidence_basis: IN appointment routes; HU process; PC08–PC09.

journey: Returning client reuses or updates verified measurements
acceptance: Original values, revisions and reviewer are traceable. Selecting a stored profile requires authorization and cannot leak household/other-client measurements.
evidence_basis: Proper Cloth repeat-fit accounts; Oliver Wicks measurement guidance.

journey: Guided remote measurements and photo-assisted fit review
current_prototype: Absent; earlier v2 four-field experiment is not an approved measurement system.
acceptance: Plausibility rules come from a qualified tailor. Incomplete data cannot become approved. Movement preferences such as sitting or performance are recorded explicitly.
evidence_basis: HK profile entry; PC fit routes; OW/Sartoro qualitative reviews.

journey: Request, book, reschedule or cancel a fitting
acceptance: Real calendar receipt required for Confirmed. Time zones and event deadlines are explicit. Cancellation updates both client and staff records.
evidence_basis: IN07–IN11; HU03; Lanieri booking complaints.

journey: Review the complete design and request a quote
current_prototype: Partial: editable review, prepare, print and JSON export; no actual submission.
acceptance: Request source IDs match export and staff view. Quote request is not purchase, redemption or booking. Download/print remains available independently.
evidence_basis: SS07–SS09; PC specifications; IN Save-to-bag confusion.

journey: Collaborate with a named concierge
acceptance: No changes applied through informal chat alone. Staff sees the same current version; ownership transfer preserves case history.
evidence_basis: OW guidance; SS automated-loop complaints; Huntsman continuity.

journey: Approve quote and optionally pay
acceptance: Webhooks are idempotent and server-verified. Customer cannot pay an old quote to obtain new specifications. Discounts, benefits and refunds are auditable.
evidence_basis: Proposed commerce; research did not complete competitor purchases.

journey: Track production and manage an event deadline
acceptance: Every milestone has a source/time. Staff cannot conceal an unresolved fit/quality issue by marking an item shipped. Event-risk communication is recorded.
evidence_basis: SS/IN/OW/Sartoro deadline reviews.

journey: Receive the suit and assess first fit
acceptance: Original garment specification remains visible. Fit-check photos are private and purpose-scoped. Acceptance does not silently waive rights outside approved terms.
evidence_basis: Proper Cloth remake accounts; IN post-delivery gaps.

journey: Request an alteration or remake
acceptance: Each correction versions measurements and links to the original issue. Follow-up checks actual fit before asking whether service was successful.
evidence_basis: Proper Cloth two-remake positive account; SS alteration and IN reimbursement complaints.

journey: Cancel, return, exchange or request a refund
acceptance: Partial refunds and exchanges reconcile with payments/benefits. No duplicate returns, lost labels or bot-only loops. Request cannot silently cancel unrelated garments.
evidence_basis: SS returns-loop complaints; IN post-sale friction; negative PC review checks.

journey: Reorder from a successful suit
acceptance: Equivalent supplier ID is verified rather than inferred from a similar colour. Current policies/benefits apply visibly.
evidence_basis: Proper Cloth and OW repeat-order reviews.

journey: Export or delete personal data and close an account
acceptance: Deletion and export do not expose another client. Cache, backups and vendor retention follow disclosed policy. Removing a photo does not accidentally cancel an order.
evidence_basis: Proposed privacy design; provider retention differs from NYONI storage.

journey: Coordinate wedding or group designs
acceptance: Permissions distinguish shared styling from private personal data. Group consistency is explicit without promising identical fit or shared ownership.
evidence_basis: Wedding-order review pain points; proposed NYONI service.

journey: Intake, assignment and concierge queue
acceptance: Every acknowledged request appears in the queue once. The client sees the same owner/status. A staff absence cannot orphan a case.
evidence_basis: Customer support/communication complaints.

journey: Approve catalogue materials and compatibility
current_prototype: Partial extraction exists; approval/availability tools absent.
acceptance: Every exposed option has provenance and an owner. Only supported combinations can be submitted as approved; all imagery is versioned.
evidence_basis: PC compatibility and selected-component complaints; original PDFs.

journey: Review measurements and approve fit profiles
acceptance: Only authorized fitting staff can approve. Measurement revisions explain the difference and cannot overwrite a different order/client profile.
evidence_basis: PC/OW/Sartoro fit-review findings.

journey: Quote, entitlement and commercial review
acceptance: Client and staff totals match. Financial and entitlement adjustments have authorized owners and cannot be changed by client-side state.
evidence_basis: SS information clarity; NYONI membership requirements.

journey: Release production and handle specification changes
acceptance: Factory/tailor receives the same IDs approved by client. A changed quote or photo result cannot automatically mutate a released order.
evidence_basis: Specification-mismatch reviews; proposed operational control.

journey: Operate and review personal-preview jobs
acceptance: No cross-client cache or access. Identity/body/construction failures are not disguised as success. Provider deletion limitations remain disclosed.
evidence_basis: Proposed personal-preview quality/privacy plan.

journey: Resolve aftercare, returns and payment remedies
acceptance: Refund confirmation is distinct from approval; reopened cases retain history. Staff cannot mark payment refunded on an unverified message.
evidence_basis: SS support loops; PC remakes; IN reimbursement complaints.

journey: Manage access, privacy and deletion requests
release: Connected service; required before photo pilot
acceptance: Cross-account access tests, staff role checks, expiry and deletion checks pass before pilot. Legal/policy exceptions require documented review.
evidence_basis: Photo-provider retention research; proposed service control.
